name: Eyepetizer - Tour
summary: Welcome to the Eyepetizer house, a virtual adventure where you will immerse yourself in the world of this quirky and colourful family. This VR app for Meta Quest will take you on an interactive tour through the Eyepetizer house, where you will meet Lola, the mum who talks to her plants; Fried, the absent-minded and thoughtful dad; Scarlet and Rafael, the two young sons devoted to photography and sculpture; Pinta, the grandmother fascinated by sports and handsome young men; Diego, the inconclusive musician u
